correctness.rationale: For each m>=2 the actual length-four m-arm graph has middle matching subcomplex K0=(S^0)^{*m}. Each Xi obtained by adjoining Ai,Di to K0 is the join of a contractible Ind(P4) with m-1 zero-spheres; Xi∩Xj=K0. Every face outside Y=∪Xi is paired by insertion/deletion of Ci where Ai and Dj with i≠j occur, in decreasing face-size order; no second endpoint edge can be added. This is an elementary collapse onto G-invariant Y (not an equivariant matching). Relative LES for (Y,K0) gives H_m as kernel of Z^m -> Z. Its natural group action twists the augmentation lattice by the orientation character on the join: sign(σ)*(-1)^{m e}. Thus the integral S_m×C2 module, not merely rational dimension, and trace sign(σ)(-1)^{me}(fixed_arms-1) follow. Boundaries m=2 and pole parity checked; finite checks m=2,3,4 generated faces and corresponding removal pair counts.
